s1.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with skin lesions in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: tender annular erythematous plaques on the neck and trunk
violaceous and crusted centers with purpura and edematous rings
key_facts: tender lesions on the neck and trunk
recent chemotherapy with ixazomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone
skin biopsy showing inflammatory infiltrate of mononuclear cells
immunohistochemistry positive for CD68 and myeloperoxidase

raw.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with skin lesions in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: tender annular erythematous plaques on the neck and trunk
violaceous and crusted centers with purpura and edematous rings
key_facts: tender lesions on the neck and trunk
recent chemotherapy with ixazomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone
skin biopsy showing inflammatory infiltrate of mononuclear cells
immunohistochemistry positive for CD68 and myeloperoxidase

shortlist.label: Sweet syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: immunocompromised patient with fever and tender skin lesions, consistent with Sweet syndrome

shortlist.label: Ecthyma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: febrile illness with skin lesions in an immunocompromised patient, consistent with Ecthyma gangrenosum

shortlist.label: Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis
shortlist.why_kept: fever and skin lesions in an immunocompromised patient, consistent with Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis

shortlist.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions with inflammatory infiltrate, although no obvious leukocytoclastic vasculitis

shortlist.label: Disseminated herpes zoster
shortlist.why_kept: immunocompromised patient with fever and skin lesions, although no clear evidence of herpes zoster

shortlist.label: Pseudomonas aeruginosa sepsis
shortlist.why_kept: immunocompromised patient with fever, although blood culture was negative

shortlist.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: immunocompromised patient with fever, although no clear evidence of CMV infection

shortlist.label: Varicella-zoster virus infection
shortlist.why_kept: immunocompromised patient with fever and skin lesions, although no clear evidence of VZV infection

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of fever, tender lesions on the neck and trunk, and skin biopsy showing inflammatory infiltrate of mononuclear cells, along with positive immunohistochemistry for CD68 and myeloperoxidase, is consistent with Sweet syndrome, especially in the context of recent chemotherapy and a history of multiple myeloma.

rejected.label: Ecthyma gangrenosum
rejected.why: Negative blood culture and lack of obvious leukocytoclastic vasculitis make this less likely

rejected.label: Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis
rejected.why: Low white blood cell count and lack of specific findings related to eccrine glands

rejected.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
rejected.why: Nuclear dust present but no obvious leukocytoclastic vasculitis

rejected.label: Disseminated herpes zoster
rejected.why: No mention of a vesicular rash or other typical herpes zoster findings

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: No specific findings or tests mentioned for CMV

rejected.label: Varicella-zoster virus infection
rejected.why: No mention of a vesicular rash or other typical VZV findings
